(3) COMBINED run of all suites together -> 147/147 PASSED in 151s, confirming no cross-suite interference. DEPLOY STATE ITEMS ALL CONFIRMED TRUE: frontend/.env and backend/.env both exist, are non-empty, and `git check-ignore` returns rc=1 (NOT ignored) thanks to the '!frontend/.env' / '!backend/.env' negations still present in /app/.gitignore; MONGO_URL+DB_NAME and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL keys intact. backend/requirements.txt still declares fastapi>=0.110.0,<0.116 (asserted via packaging.Requirement: allows 0.115.14, rejects 0.116.0 AND 0.141.0), plus annotated-doc>=0.0.5 and click>=8.1.0; root and backend manifests are still byte-identical. server.py shim imports cleanly from cwd=/app/backend and `server.app is app.main.app` -> True (same singleton, /api routes exposed). LIVE SMOKE (all against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, no localhost): GET /api/health -> 200 status=healthy; seeded QA login ingretest@ingrelens.dev -> 200 + bearer token; GET /api/profile -> 200 with the previously-saved avatar still present and no MongoDB _id leaked; GET /api/barcode/3017620422003?mode=FOOD -> 200 Nutella; POST /api/scan with barcode only (multipart form) -> 200 with a real Claude analysis (ingredients populated, no fallback marker, barcode.code echoed). AUTH PLAYBOOK RE-VERIFIED: bcrypt hash for the seeded user is $2b$12$ (correct format); brute-force lockout still works (5x wrong password -> 401, 6th -> 429, and the CORRECT password is then also 429 — lockout is per-identifier via the login_attempts collection); no httpOnly auth cookie is set on login because the app is intentionally bearer-token based (only Set-Cookie is Cloudflare's __cf_bm), so the cookie/CSRF portion of the playbook does not apply; there is no admin/seed_admin flow in this app. CONCLUSION: zero runtime regressions found — the backend is deploy-ready.

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING, unchanged since iterations 5-7 and NOT a regression: allow_origins defaults to ["*"] while allow_credentials=True. Re-verified live this iteration — OPTIONS /api/health with 'Origin: https://evil.example' returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *'. Fails playbook item (3) 'CORS allows credentials with explicit origins'. Non-blocking for deploy (app uses bearer tokens, not cookies) but should be tightened by setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit preview/production origins.

action_items: Nothing blocking. The production redeploy can proceed — 147/147 backend tests green and all four deployment-critical state items verified.
Optional hardening (carried over, still open): set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins instead of the "*" default, since allow_credentials=True is incompatible with a wildcard origin.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/scan accepts multipart Form fields only (barcode/text/mode/product_name via Form(...)), so a JSON body silently degrades to 'Add a label photo, barcode or paste the label text first' (400) instead of a 415/422. This is a real API-contract footgun for any future client that posts JSON — consider returning 415 for unsupported content types so the failure is self-explanatory.

GET /api/barcode/{code} requires an Authorization header but the handler takes it as a bare `authorization: str | None = Header(None)` rather than a shared dependency; auth enforcement is duplicated per-endpoint. Extracting a `Depends(current_user)` dependency would prevent a future endpoint from accidentally shipping unauthenticated.

emergentintegrations is still the only dependency without an upper bound; a major release there can re-trigger the resolution drift that caused the original annotated_doc production crash. Consider bounding it.

The shim's `sys.path.insert` of the parent dir means the app breaks with a bare 'ModuleNotFoundError: app' if the deployer ever copies only /app/backend into the image. A defensive try/except with an explicit message would make that failure obvious in deploy logs.

IMPORTANT API CONTRACT GOTCHAS I hit: POST /api/scan takes multipart FORM data (use requests `data=`, NOT `json=`), and GET /api/barcode/{code} REQUIRES an Authorization bearer header (returns 401 'Please log in to continue' without it). Do not brute-force the seeded QA account — the lockout is per-identifier and will 429 even the correct password for several minutes; use a throwaway registered user instead. The upstream OpenFoodFacts record for barcode 3017620422003 has crowd-edited ingredients_text, so assert on 'nutella' appearing in the response rather than exact ingredient strings. Only open item is the CORS wildcard + allow_credentials nit in app/main.py.

rca_of_the_issue: No regression found, so no RCA required for this pass. The two initial failures in my new suite were defects in MY test script, not the application: I posted /api/scan as JSON (endpoint uses Form(...) fields) and called GET /api/barcode/{code} without an Authorization header (endpoint is auth-protected). Both were corrected within test-only scope and then passed; no application code was touched. The previously-fixed production crash (ModuleNotFoundError: annotated_doc from an unbounded fastapi>=0.110.0 resolving to 0.141.x) remains correctly mitigated: the fastapi<0.116 upper bound and the explicit annotated-doc + click entries are still present and byte-identical across both manifests, and both uvicorn entry points resolve to the same FastAPI instance.
